## List Tree Indentation Guides 1.0.3

- Fixes separate list blocks being joined by guide groups or continuation/gutter spines; bridging separate blocks is now an explicit searchable setting and is disabled by default.
- Fixes Live Preview and Source-mode threading so hovering anywhere across a visible list-item row activates the thread, rather than requiring a narrow connector target.
- Adds **Active List Item Threading** (enabled by default) for the hovered item’s ancestor path.
- Adds **All Branches of an Active Bullet List Threading** (disabled by default) for the complete hovered list block.
- Uses the existing Style Settings thread colors, opacity, thickness, caps, corner radius, connector geometry, and Reading-mode geometry for both threading subfeatures.
- Retains independent mode toggles, searchable settings, exact synchronized Style Settings number inputs, viewport-bounded rendering, default-visible list markers, and GitHub attestations for `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css`.
